attribution: FLEURS: Few-shot Learning Evaluation of Universal Representations of Speech, Conneau et al., Google, 2022.
selection: First 20 eligible archive members per language; distinct sentence IDs; duration >= 8s. Not a random or representative population sample.
audio_changes: Original WAV files retained unchanged. For inference, full mono 16 kHz float audio clipped to [-1,1] and converted in memory to PCM16 WAV. Both hashes retained in records.jsonl.
benchmark_subset: All 240 selected recordings, full duration; no VAD trimming or further filtering.
vad: Not used for this GPU benchmark.
parallel_reference_note: reference_translations joins original FLEURS test transcriptions across languages by sentence ID. Selected audio need not contain every sentence in every language; reference text availability is explicit per entry.
text_changes: Original source/reference/hypothesis texts retained; NFC and whitespace-normalized scoring derivatives exported. Case, punctuation and numeric differences retained, followed by the declared metric tokenization.
evaluation: All 240 saved direct speech translations: 220 to English, 20 to German. One target reference joined by source sentence ID. No additional inference.
